title: Krea Agents adds project context and Pinterest import
summary: Krea Agents is reported to combine project-file context, Pinterest moodboards, reusable image-based skills and connected work tools in an application-based creative agent workspace.
research_notes:
Request access through the Agents beta flow; reporting describes access as application-based.

Upload project files and references, then describe the intended result and choose the available language-model and effort settings.

Import a Pinterest moodboard or other visual reference, and create an image-set skill when a recurring style needs to be invoked from prompts.

Connect Slack, Figma or Google Drive when their project material is needed in the agent context; review generated media before using its reported social-publishing capability.

Keep the brief, references and reusable style material together in the project context before asking for a multi-step result; Krea’s earlier Node Agent documentation shows the platform plans from existing canvas state and lets users review a plan before execution.

Review the proposed workflow and model choices before running generation: Krea’s Node Agent documentation says it presents a plan and per-node compute cost before execution.
